data.long_meaning: The name Gulab is derived from the Sanskrit word 'gul' meaning jaggery or sweet. It is often used as a term of endearment and is a popular name for baby girls in Hindu culture. The name Gulab carries the meaning “Sweet like Jaggery” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gulab usually hope their child will grow to embody sweet like jaggery and live with faith, good character and purpose.
